description: This file contains the PHP class `Online` which extends the OpenCart system controller. It provides functionality for the online dashboard extension, including methods to display the dashboard, save settings (via AJAX), and retrieve online customer data. It is part of the `Opencart.Admin.Controller.Extension.Opencart.Dashboard` namespace and is focused on managing online customer information within the admin dashboard.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Controller class for the 'Online' dashboard extension, managing display and settings for online customer tracking in the admin dashboard.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the dashboard page by loading language, setting the title, preparing breadcrumbs, and rendering the online dashboard view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to save configuration settings for the online dashboard widget; checks permissions, updates settings, and returns a JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns a view of the current number of online customers with formatted total count and a link to detailed report.
